title: What if the Sun became a black hole? 🕳️
subject: sun
description:
Where would you rather be when the lights go out? 👇

What would happen to Earth if the Sun turned into a black hole with the same mass? Our orbit stays the same, but the sky goes black and the oceans start to freeze.

Sources: NASA Imagine the Universe, "If the Sun became a black hole"; NASA, "What Is a Black Hole?"; Caltech, "If the sun ceased to exist right now, how long would mankind survive?" (Prof. Dave Stevenson); IFLScience, "If The Sun Turned Into A Black Hole, Earth Would Continue Its Orbit".

scenes.text: Imagine the Sun crushed to the size of a town.
Same mass, just 3 kilometers in radius. For 8 minutes, you'd notice nothing.
Then noon turns black. NASA says Earth's orbit wouldn't change at all.
Caltech's Dave Stevenson worked out the cold: within a week, the oceans start icing over. In a year, the surface nears minus 100 degrees Fahrenheit.
Our real Sun is far too small to ever become a black hole.
